summary: Second 2026-11-15 session: the remaining gameplay in BW2's engine for Platinum and HGSS. Bug-Catching Contest, legendaries, roamers, Giratina, the nickname question, the Pokedex entry and PC line after a catch, obedience levels, Mom's line, the catching tutorial, Apricorn Ball colours. Everything is pushed and passes desktop (Docker) tests; nothing was built for or tried on the AYN Thor, and platinum-thor does not have it.
read_first: ~/pokeplatinum-thor-ls/docs/thor/dev/gen5-battles.md (sections 'The rest of the battles, second pass' and 'After the catch, and the catching tutorial')
~/pokeplatinum-thor-ls/docs/thor/dev/hgss.md (section 'The Bug-Catching Contest, legendaries, roamers and the rest')

rules.no_session_links: No Claude-Session lines or session links in commits or PR descriptions
never_commit: anything from a BW2 or HGSS ROM (the Apricorn palettes and arenas are generated at run time into gen5_data/)
rules.pokebw2_untouched: Never edit ../pokebw2; changes go in gen5/patches as diffs. Re-diff with the scratch a/ b/ copies, then check no '+' lines were lost (comm -23 of old and new '+' lines)
rules.foreign_uncommitted_changes: In the Platinum checkout, docs/thor/dev/gen5-battles.md (12 lines about the 3D layer's alpha), subprojects/libntr.wrap and subprojects/packagefiles/libntr_3d_premultiplied.patch belong to someone else; never commit them. To commit your own section of gen5-battles.md: build it on 'git show HEAD:...', git hash-object -w, git update-index --cacheinfo, then put the working-tree copy (with their hunks plus yours) back
rules.upstream_prs: None until the work is fully working and debugged

next_steps.item: Build and install on the Thor
next_steps.how: Platinum: merge gen5-battles into platinum-thor (do not commit the foreign files), push, gh run download the pokeplatinum-android artifact, adb install -r. HGSS: tools/docker/desktop.sh apk in ~/pokeheartgold-thor-ls, adb install -r. Ask the owner for the adb 'IP address & Port'. Then play: a catch of a new species (Pokedex entry, nickname question), a full-party catch, a contest at the National Park, a trainer battle with a traded Pokemon (obedience).

The Pokedex entry (both games), the naming screen and HGSS's contest swap screen show 4:3 after a widescreen battle; check how other 4:3 screens are framed on the Thor (src/port/widescreen.c, SIM_SetWidescreen*) and give them the same bezel or edge extension

Like the Safari Zone's view-only battle (gen5/src/safari.c) but Park Balls always catch and there is no bait or rock; check first whether Pal Park is reachable at all on the port (it needs a GBA cartridge's Pokemon)
BATTLE_TYPE_FRONTIER battles stay in the native engines; BW2 has BTL_TYPE_FACILITY (its Subway) with level scaling and no items/exp. Large: start with the Battle Tower singles

next_steps.item: Apricorn Ball art on the ground
next_steps.how: Now one colour each on BW2's Poke Ball frames (Level comes out tan). Better: take each ball's colours from BW2's own particle textures (they have true art for all 25 balls), or redraw frames

Platinum and HGSS show the Pokedex entry before the nickname question; here the question (in BW2's battle) comes first. Moving the question after the entry would need the question outside BW2 (a field-style yes/no after the battle)
Never set by Platinum's C code; check the scripts before deciding whether to accept them
Make trainer and wild tests fail on a lost battle (check the log's BW2 result or add a test check command), and make gen5_wild handle a failed escape

workflows.hgss_build_test: cd ~/pokeheartgold-thor-ls && tools/docker/desktop.sh build && tools/docker/desktop.sh test tests/scripts/NAME.txt --from new-game

gotchas: HGSS CreateMon with OT_ID_PLAYER_ID gives OT ID 0: use OT_ID_PRESET with the player's ID
A test that doesn't check the result passes a lost battle: grep the log for 'battle ended (BW2's result N' (1 won, 0 lost, 3/4 ran, 5 caught)
BW2's battle leaves the master brightness faded out: reset it before showing a game screen after the battle
Game screens run outside their battle need the battle's font (Platinum FONT_SUBSCREEN, HGSS FontID 4)
BW2's yes/no and move menus: the first pad press only shows the cursor; tests touch YES at (128, 55)
BtlvEffect_CalcGaugeHP takes the HP left, not the damage
BW2's thrown and opening balls are particles with art for all 25 balls; archive 94's sprite pairs are only the ball on the ground
gen5_data/ archives are regenerated when ROCKET_VERSION (HGSS) or GALACTIC_VERSION (Platinum) changes
